functionalReqs: Versioned eval datasets per feature (golden sets, adversarial sets)
Automatic eval runs on every prompt/model change, with a pass/fail gate
LLM-as-judge plus human review for subjective quality
Runtime input and output filters (PII, toxicity, jailbreaks, prompt injection)
hints: What makes an eval trustworthy? Think about dataset coverage, judge reliability and reproducibility.
Split offline (CI-style evals) from online (runtime guardrails and production sampling).

Eval service: datasets in versioned storage, runners calling the candidate prompt/model with fixed seeds, metric plugins (exact match, rubric-based LLM judge calibrated against humans, pairwise comparisons), regression gates in CI. Guardrails: fast classifiers for input (injection, jailbreak, PII) and output (toxicity, PII leakage, groundedness checks), policy engine deciding block/redact/rewrite; production sampling feeds new eval cases.
problemStatement: Design the **evaluation and guardrails** system for a company shipping several LLM features: offline evals that gate every prompt or model change, and runtime guardrails that block unsafe inputs and outputs.

scaleHints.storage: Eval runs and sampled production traces

title: Design an LLM Evaluation & Guardrails Pipeline
